title: env.sandbox.matrix request
description: Run a named set of sandbox calls that share one recipe and vary its inputs, writing nothing. `read_only`. The source, load map, stack, chip model, watches and exports are the experiment's apparatus and are shared; what a case may change is what the routine is handed. Every case is expanded and normalized before any of them runs, so a malformed case refuses the matrix rather than producing half a sweep.

hunk.description: Which CODE hunk to run. Defaults to the first.

load_origin.description: Absolute address the selected hunk is mapped at.

entry_offset.description: Byte offset within the hunk to start at.

hunk_bases.description: Additional hunks to map, for relocations that target them. A hunk relocated into but not mapped is an error, not a silent skip: the code would run with an address that means nothing and the trace would not say so.

maximum_steps.description: Instructions to execute before stopping. Clamped to what the executing context allows — 200000 by default, and at most 50000000 for a host running local media it has reviewed. Sandbox code is unknown code, and a request for an unbounded run would be asking the process to hang, so the budget is always finite. A reduction is reported as LIMIT_REDUCED.

watch.description: Absolute ranges whose accesses are attached to trace rows. At most 64: every watched range is compared against every memory access, so the list is a per-access cost rather than a per-request one. An excess is refused rather than truncated, because a dropped watchpoint would make a run that observed nothing indistinguishable from one that had nothing to observe.

stop_on_watch.description: Stop at the first instruction that touches a watched range.

trace.description: Whether to return the per-instruction trace. Watching implies recording even without this, or a watch hit would stop the run with nothing to point at.

stack_arguments.description: Longwords placed above the return marker: at entry SP holds the marker and SP+4 is the first argument, as a JSR would leave them.

mapped_regions.description: Regions the routine reads or writes, beyond the hunks it runs in.

interrupts.description: Interrupts delivered on a deterministic instruction schedule. Setup code commonly sets a synchronization flag and spins until an interrupt handler clears it; the beam counter advances on its own, but nothing runs the handler, so otherwise valid initialization never returns. The schedule is in instructions rather than in beam or wall-clock time because that is the one clock a sandbox reproduces exactly.

memory_exports.description: Ranges of the sandbox's final memory the recipe names as artifacts. The record digests each one; `env.sandbox.call.export` writes their bytes beside the record. A range not fully mapped is refused rather than exported short.

memory_seeds.description: Bytes written into the sandbox before entry. Each seed spells its bytes out as `hex`, copies them from a range with `from`, or replays them from a pinned `artifact` — exactly one of the three, since a seed with two would have two answers to what it seeds and one with none would seed nothing while looking like it seeded something.

cases.description: The cases, in the order they run and are reported. Every field but `name` is an override; absent means "as the shared recipe has it", which is what makes a case readable as a difference rather than as a whole recipe repeated.

name.description: Unique within the matrix, and usable as one path component so a case can name an artifact later. Uniqueness is what lets a result be matched to a case by something other than its position.

entry_offset.description: Byte offset within the hunk to start at.

stack_arguments.description: Replaces the shared stack arguments outright rather than appending: a call's arguments are positional, and appending would shift them.

memory_seeds.description: Applied after the shared seeds, so a case seeding an address the recipe also seeds overwrites it. Appending rather than replacing is what lets a case vary one field of a large shared structure.

notes.description: What this case is for, in the record. Never interpreted.

maximum_cases.description: Cap on expanded cases. Clamped by the context, with LIMIT_REDUCED.

maximum_total_steps.description: Instructions the whole matrix may execute. Separate from the per-case budget and not its multiple: a case is never clipped to what is left, it either runs with the budget it asked for or is reported as not run. Defaults to one run's budget, which is deliberately conservative.
